To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the time-based authoring tools can be used to manage and visualize history of authoring, and to support informal information management.

(1) time-based slicing of the authoring process provides the author with a new way to manage his or her own information, (2) the history-centric approach can be applied to any type of editor or drawing tool, and (3) the time-based approach is more useful for informal information management than the conventional approach that is based on the concept of revision.

the history-centric approach to authoring provides an effective and efficient way to support the generation of creative works, and that the Time-based Slicers can provide the users with the necessary level of granularity for the visualization of the history data, which is essential in the history-centric approach.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions.
the design and development for supporting the authoring of informal information management, and the evaluation of the approach and the developed tools.
the design and development issues of time-based authoring tools for informal information management.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
HeEditor and HeSketch provide a new way of authoring that allows users to interactively visualize and manipulate their historical data in a time-based manner.
the time-based authoring tool provides a useful way to support informal information management.
HeEditor and HeSketch are two history-centric tools for supporting the authoring process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Time-based Slicers are a powerful tool to support informal information management, which is an important component in the overall support of creative knowledge work.
we provide an authoring tool that is able to support both time-based information management and time-based information visualization.
we have designed and developed history-based authoring tools to help people manage and reuse their own historical information in the process of generating their own writings and drawings.

history is a valuable asset in authoring, which can be used to support various types of authoring tasks.
history-centric authoring is an important approach for supporting the creative knowledge work.
the Time-based Slicer is an essential component in time-based authoring tools for informal information management.
